local self=require('openmw.self')
local core=require('openmw.core')
local types=require('openmw.types')
local nearby=require('openmw.nearby')
local camera=require('openmw.camera')
local util=require('openmw.util')
local t=0
return {{engineHandlers={{onFrame=function(dt)
 t=t+dt;if t<.2 then return end;t=0
 assert(not types.Actor.isDead(self),'Player died returning to Savlian barricade')
 local target=nil
 for _,actor in ipairs(nearby.actors) do
  if actor.recordId==core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',0x028007) then target=actor;break end
 end
 if not target then print('SavlianArrival target not resident');return end
 local distance=(target.position-self.position):length()
 print('SavlianArrival control ready distance='..distance..' player='..tostring(self.position)..' target='..tostring(target.position))
 if core.isWorldPaused() then
  if distance<600 then print('SavlianArrival dialogue opened') end
  return
 end
 local point=camera.getViewTransform():apply(target.position+util.vector3(0,0,90))
 local ax=math.atan2(point.x,-point.z);local ay=-math.atan2(point.y,math.sqrt(point.x*point.x+point.z*point.z))
 print(string.format('SavlianArrival aim x=%d y=%d distance=%.3f',math.max(-100,math.min(100,math.floor(ax*256+.5))),math.max(-100,math.min(100,math.floor(ay*256+.5))),distance))
 if math.abs(ax)<.04 and math.abs(ay)<.06 then print('SavlianArrival facing ready') end
 if distance<220 then print('SavlianArrival in reach') end
end}}}}
